description.value: A hike-in campground on the shore of glacial Kinney Lake along the Berg Lake Trail in Mount Robson Provincial Park, framed by the highest peak in the Canadian Rockies; the roughly 4 km walk from the trailhead puts it entirely out of reach for loaded touring bikes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as a backcountry campsite (backcountry=yes, tourism=camp_site) within Mount Robson Provincial Park. The linked website is the park's general BC Parks page; it confirms the Berg Lake Trail is open after repairs and that a restaurant, gift store, and gas station are near the park's western entrance, but provides no Kinney Lake-specific amenity data. Because the campsite is a backcountry hiking destination accessible only on foot, nearly all cycling-relevant amenity fields cannot be confirmed and its fit for a cycling tourism directory is ambiguous.
concerns: Kinney Lake Campground is a backcountry site reached solely by hiking trail — it is not directly accessible by bicycle.
The linked website is the general Mount Robson Park page; no Kinney Lake-specific subpage was fetched, so campsite amenities cannot be confirmed.
No address or phone number is present in OSM or on the website for this specific campsite.
The assigned community 'Unknown / Cariboo, Chilcotin & Central Interior' appears geographically incorrect; Mount Robson Park is in the Northern Rockies/Yellowhead corridor of BC.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a backcountry campsite accessible only on foot via the Berg Lake Trail and is not bicycle-accessible; its relevance to a cycling tourism directory requires human judgement before inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: The BC Parks website states the Berg Lake Trail has been fully repaired after weather-related closures and is welcoming visitors; advisories should be checked before any visit.
